text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... You have prepared a birthday 
party for me...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(To think these two would... I'd like to 
believe there's no hidden agenda, but a 
shred of doubt lingers—)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Those eyes—surely you are not doubting the 
benevolence of your King, are you?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Your constant vigilance in preparing for 
emergencies is admirable. However... I 
give you my word, I mean no harm."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It's your special birthday, isn't it? I 
simply wanted to congratulate you from the 
bottom of my heart—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
How could I ever do something so unrefined 
as to trouble your hands?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. I truly appreciate the 
thought from both of you.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I would be delighted to accept your 
invitation to the birthday party!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we? Orfe picked out both 
the flowers and the tea leaves for us.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I made sure to clean thoroughly so you 
could spend your time here in peace.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Pay no mind to the clamor, and partake in 
the feast to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I am humbled that you would go to such 
lengths for me. Then, I shall take you up 
on your offer—...hm?
